name: Glaucous-Menhir
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by solar wind erosion patterns near the terminator.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls titanium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
